I contributed to the development of the synopsis of typhoid conjugate vaccine Phase II and Phase III clinical trials.  • Design and the maintenance of the Trial Master File.  • Contribution to the prioritization of the development of clinical operations SOPs   Moreover, I am working with my supervisor (Dr Jean-Louis Excler) to the development of a manuscript on the dynamics of vaccine administration (injectable or oral) per age groups and future projections. With the Policy and Economic Research team of IVI, we also developed a protocol for the systematic review on the cholera outbreaks the review is ongoing.   2.3.4 Scientific Publications/Communications During the fellowship we have been able to successfully develop and publish several articles (List of the publication in the appendix 3). I attended also the 8th EDCTP Forum and presented a poster entitled:  M. Siribie, A.B Tiono, A.G.A Babiker, A. Sanou, L. Sermé, Z. Gansané, A. Traoré, M.F Gomes, F. Pagnoni and S.B Sirima. Impact of an Integrated Community Case Management of Fever/Malaria and Pneumonia on Child Mortality: a Cluster - Randomized Controlled Trial in Burkina Faso. Poster Communication. 8th EDCTP Forum, 6-9 November 2016, Lusaka, Zambia.  2.4 Networking Opportunities As young scientist, this fellowship programme was an opportunity to look for networking opportunities as well, for our professional support. First of all, it will be a tremendous support for me to be able to keep connexion with my host institution (IVI) after the fellowship scheme for the contribution to the ongoing clinical research activities and the conduct of future clinical research activities in Africa.
